self_audit: Kept signed key ordering includes zero-frequency bins and every excess drain row; masked rows are ignored.
Only the first MAX_BINS kept rows write RAM or update bins/TA/TB. Excess mass cannot repair a zero retained total.
Frequencies zero-extend to TOTAL_W before addition; unsigned products receive a positive sign bit before subtraction. abs(contrast)<=TA*TB fits 2*TOTAL_W.
Strict absolute improvement keeps the earliest witness across opposite-sign ties; first read initializes the zero-distance witness, whose direction stays zero.
Synchronous RAM reads complete before ROW_EVAL; collection and replay are disjoint; reset makes old prefixes unreachable.

All seven states, three multiply roles, held normal/error outputs with actual blocked source, middle/last reads/evals, overflow and empty-bin ordering are immediately canceled and followed by analytic recovery.
Every main frame checks exact tail delay; valid main frames check exactly n row evaluations and 1+2*n completed products.
